description: Verify that users can navigate between pages of product listings using pagination controls.
steps: Locate the pagination controls at the bottom of the page.
Click on the '2' link to navigate to page 2.
Wait for the page to load.
Verify that the URL changes to 'https://atid.store/store/page/2/' and products on page 2 are displayed.
Click on the 'Next page' link to navigate to page 3.
Wait for the page to load.
Verify that the URL changes to 'https://atid.store/store/page/3/' and products on page 3 are displayed.
expected_results: Users can navigate to subsequent pages of product listings using pagination controls.
The URL updates correctly as users navigate.
edge_cases: Clicking pagination controls leads to a 404 error.
Pagination controls are not keyboard accessible.
data_requirements: Multiple pages of products must exist.
Valid links for each pagination control.
dependencies: Pagination logic must be implemented in the backend.
Products must be distributed across multiple pages.
api_interactions: API call to fetch products for the selected page.
Error handling for invalid page numbers.
performance_metrics: Pagination navigation time should be under 2 seconds.
accessibility_requirements: Pagination controls must be accessible via keyboard navigation.
Ensure that active page indicators are visible and announced by screen readers.
